customrecordtype.recordname: S4VP Hồ sơ nguồn chấm công
customrecordtype.description: Attendance device / system import profile: column mapping, date format, line layout and how device IDs map to employees. Name = source code. Acumatica screen UI2. Generated by tools/gen_objects.mjs.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Kiểu dòng
customrecordcustomfield.description: E = one punch per line; P = one line with in and out time of a day; Z = ZKTeco attlog (tab separated, no header: ID, date time, status columns ignored). Empty = E.
customrecordcustomfield.help: E = one punch per line; P = one line with in and out time of a day; Z = ZKTeco attlog (tab separated, no header: ID, date time, status columns ignored). Empty = E.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Có dòng tiêu đề
customrecordcustomfield.description: The first line (after the skipped lines) holds the column names. Ignored for layout Z.
customrecordcustomfield.help: The first line (after the skipped lines) holds the column names. Ignored for layout Z.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Số dòng đầu bỏ qua
customrecordcustomfield.description: Lines skipped before the header line (report titles).
customrecordcustomfield.help: Lines skipped before the header line (report titles).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Dấu phân cách
customrecordcustomfield.description: A = detect from the first line (tab, semicolon, comma). Empty = A.
customrecordcustomfield.help: A = detect from the first line (tab, semicolon, comma). Empty = A.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cột mã chấm công
customrecordcustomfield.description: Header name (case and Vietnamese accents ignored) or column number from 1.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Header name (case and Vietnamese accents ignored) or column number from 1.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cột ngày giờ
customrecordcustomfield.description: Layout E: one column holding date and time. Leave empty to use the date and time columns.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Layout E: one column holding date and time. Leave empty to use the date and time columns.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cột ngày
customrecordcustomfield.description: Layout E (with the time column) and layout P.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Layout E (with the time column) and layout P.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cột giờ
customrecordcustomfield.description: Layout E with a separate date column.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Layout E with a separate date column.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cột giờ ra
customrecordcustomfield.description: Layout P. An out time earlier than the in time belongs to the next day (night shift).
customrecordcustomfield.help: Layout P. An out time earlier than the in time belongs to the next day (night shift).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cột thiết bị
customrecordcustomfield.description: Optional. Empty = use the default device below.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Optional. Empty = use the default device below.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Định dạng ngày
customrecordcustomfield.description: Order of day, month, year when the year is last. Excel serial numbers and AM/PM times are always accepted. Empty = DMY.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Order of day, month, year when the year is last. Excel serial numbers and AM/PM times are always accepted. Empty = DMY.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Cách nhận mã
customrecordcustomfield.description: N = NetSuite employee ID or internal id; M = mapping table only; B = mapping table first, then employee ID. Empty = B.
customrecordcustomfield.help: N = NetSuite employee ID or internal id; M = mapping table only; B = mapping table first, then employee ID. Empty = B.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Thiết bị mặc định
customrecordcustomfield.description: Device written on the punches when the file has no device column.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Device written on the punches when the file has no device column.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Lệch đồng hồ (phút)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Minutes added to every punch when the device clock is off (negative allowed).
customrecordcustomfield.help: Minutes added to every punch when the device clock is off (negative allowed).
